title: Favourites and Saved searches

summary.problem: Favourites and Saved searches share one page behind two tabs. Live shows both populated, but no empty state for either has ever been captured or designed.
summary.scope: The real Favourites and Saved searches pages (captured from live, 2026-09-29) on desktop and mobile web, plus a proposed empty state for each tab. Everything except the list block of the empty states is an exact copy of production.
summary.changed: v3 replaces the hand-built pages with the live captures and derives the empty states from them. The hand-built pages had a different title, tabs with counts, and a saved-search layout that live does not use.

signoff.meaning: layout and copy are confirmed against live before build

exclude.tokens: the screens are frozen live captures; their CSS is production's own, not this system's token sheet

rules.text: The tab strip has two tabs, 'Favourites' and 'Saved searches', with no counts (shown uppercase by CSS). The Saved searches tab is shown only when the saved-searches feature is enabled for the market.
rules.test: With the feature off only 'Favourites' renders; with it on both render and neither label carries a number.

rules.text: The Favourites empty state renders only when the list has loaded, contains zero ads, and is not loading. While loading, the list shows its loading placeholders.
rules.test: Mock a loaded empty response: 'No favorites yet.' shows. Mock a pending request: it does not.

rules.text: The Favourites empty state is a single bold line with no image and no button.
rules.test: The empty-state container has one text node and no or

rules.text: A saved search is a bordered card: its title, one row per filter (label, then the value in bold), and a trash button at the top-right. There is no separate 'View results' button in the capture.
rules.test: Each card has exactly one title, at least one label/value row, and one button that deletes it.

rules.text: Deleting the last saved search shows 'No saved searches yet.'
rules.test: Delete the only card: the list is replaced by the empty-state line.

rules.text: Switching tabs swaps the list in place. Desktop shows the breadcrumb 'Profile' and the title 'Favourites & Saved searches'; mobile shows a back arrow and 'Favourites & Saved Searches'.
rules.test: Click 'Saved searches': the list changes and the underline moves; the title stays.

acceptance: Tab labels match the source strings: 'Favourites', 'Saved searches'.
Both empty-state strings render verbatim, including the US spelling in 'No favorites yet.'
edge_cases: A saved-search title that is very long: check it against the card width (not verified on live).
A favourite ad with no seller logo and no specs (the iPhone in the capture) keeps the same row heights as its neighbours.

open_questions.q: Is Saved searches enabled in Egypt? The monorepo gates it behind isSavedSearchesEnabled(); 'No saved searches yet.' was found only in the Jordan locale.
Confirm the empty-state wording on live. 'No favorites yet.' uses US spelling next to the 'Favourites' tab.
What is the size of the empty-state line? The monorepo uses Text.Large, which was not measured; 1.8rem bold is a stand-in.
The desktop title reads 'Favourites & Saved searches' but the mobile title reads 'Favourites & Saved Searches' (capital S). Is that intended?
Does deleting a saved search or un-saving an ad ask for confirmation? The capture is read-only, so live's behaviour was not observed.

changelog.notes: Screens are now the live captures of Favourites and Saved searches; the empty states are derived from them. Removed the hand-built pages, the saved-search layout I had invented, and the mobile 'no heart' question (a mistake in the hand-built page: live has the heart).
Added the mobile prototype flow, a platform switch in the prototype runner, and an open question about un-saving on mobile.
First build. Favourites and Saved searches, desktop and mobile, with empty states. Copy and structure from the maple monorepo; not verified on live.
